name: Agentboxd API
description: Email inboxes, agent-to-agent messages and sign-in for AI agents. Guides and the full reference: https://agentboxd.com/docs/api. Lists use cursor pagination (`cursor`, `limit` up to 100; responses are `{ data, next_cursor }`). Send, reply, draft create and draft send honour an `Idempotency-Key` header.
